description: The hand-written input of conformance/scripts/error_registry.py: how recorded rows and error-layer gate cells are classified into the route x error kind matrix, which message has no recorded Loki answer and why, and where Loki checks one error before another. Everything else (the per-message registry items, the status views, conformance/registry/generated/error-coverage.json and docs/error-compatibility-coverage.md) is generated from internal/lokierr, the recorded Loki answers and the gates. A new lokierr message, route or failure mode that this file does not classify fails the conformance gate.

kinds.label: Parameters
kinds.about: A request parameter, URL or form body Loki cannot read or does not accept (start, end, since, step, limit, direction, interval, delay_for, aggregateBy, URL escapes, oversize bodies).

kinds.label: LogQL syntax
kinds.about: A query Loki cannot parse: empty, unterminated, bad tokens.

kinds.label: LogQL validation
kinds.about: A query that parses but Loki rejects while checking it: matcher rules, stage compile errors, wrong query type for the route, aggregation and function rules.

kinds.label: Limits
kinds.about: A request over a limit Loki enforces: query length, lookback, series, resolution.

kinds.label: Backend failure
kinds.about: The storage behind the proxy fails or answers something the proxy cannot use: Loki answers 500, or its queue-full 429, in its own words.

kinds.label: Methods and routing
kinds.about: A path Loki's router does not know, a method a route does not serve, a tail request that is no websocket upgrade.

kinds.label: Tenant
kinds.about: A tenant header Loki or the proxy rejects.

kinds.label: Cancel and deadline
kinds.about: The client goes away (499) or the request runs out of time (504).

route_labels.other_routes: other routes (rules views, push, delete, shards, exemplars, aliases)

backend_cells_reason: A shared stack's Loki cannot be failed for one request, so there is no recorded Loki answer. The expected status and text are Loki's fixed ones (internal/lokierr constructors), and TestErrorLayer_NoVictoriaLogsLeak holds the proxy's answer to them for every route and failure mode.
tenant_cells_reason: The recorded Loki runs with authentication disabled and ignores the tenant header, so its tenant answers are not recorded and the rows cannot be compared.

stage_notes.request_decoding: The URL and form body are decoded first.
stage_notes.parameters: Parameters are read next, in the order end, start, limit, step and direction; an end not after the start and the 11,000-point resolution check come before the query is parsed.
stage_notes.logql_syntax: The query text is parsed; a syntax error is answered before the query-length limit on query_range, and on tail before the parameters.
stage_notes.limits: The query-length limit follows the syntax check on query_range and comes before it on the metadata routes.
stage_notes.logql_validation: Checks of a query that parsed (stage compilation, matcher rules, query type) come last.

limit-series.reason: The series limit needs a Loki query that reaches max_query_series; the recorded Loki has a series cap far above any recorded request, so no answer was recorded. The text is Loki's fixed one.

limit-reached.reason: Loki answers a query over one of its evaluation limits (logqlmodel.ErrLimit) with 400 and this fixed text, but the recorded stack has no limit that one request can reach, so no answer was recorded. The proxy uses the class for the limits it enforces that Loki has no flag for (the proxy-evaluated metric row limit, the binary evaluation budgets, the multi-tenant fanout); the flag goes to the log line only.

limit-response-size.reason: Loki's querier answers a response above its gRPC message size with 500 and this text, but the recorded stack cannot be made to build such a response for one request. The proxy answers it for every response it refuses to buffer above its configured bound; the flag goes to the log line only.

queue-full.reason: Loki answers a full query queue only under load; a single recorded request cannot reach it. The status and text are Loki's fixed ones.

canceled.reason: Loki answers 499 only to a request its client cancels, which a recorded request cannot do. The status and text are Loki's fixed ones.

deadline.reason: Loki answers 504 only after its query_timeout, which a recorded request cannot reach. The status and text are Loki's fixed ones.

backend-failed.reason: Loki answers 500 when its storage fails, which cannot be provoked for one recorded request. The status and text are Loki's fixed ones.

internal.reason: Loki answers 500 for a failure of its own work, which cannot be provoked for one recorded request. The status and text are Loki's fixed ones.

write-not-supported.reason: The proxy serves Loki's read API only; Loki accepts a push, so there is no Loki answer to record. A POST to /loki/api/v1/push answers 405 with this proxy text, a documented limit (semantics/push-route-read-only-answer).

unmapped_messages.template: (empty body) 301 Moved Permanently to the cleaned path
unmapped_messages.about: A path with a double slash, dot segments or an empty segment is redirected to its cleaned form by Loki's router.
A tail request that asks to upgrade to a protocol other than websocket.

unmapped_messages.template: targetBytesPerShard must be a positive value

unmapped_messages.about: A push request with an empty or corrupt body.
The delete API without a query.

unmapped_messages.body: ^(unable to read rule dir|error parsing /tmp|GetRuleGroup unsupported)
unmapped_messages.about: The rules views answer with the ruler's local-store errors.

unmapped_messages.template: unexpected expr type (<type>) for Evaluator type (<type>)
unmapped_messages.about: A query the evaluator has no case for.
approx_topk without the shard aggregations limit set.
